recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current FHIR core edit is needed for FHIR-16319; any future change should come from a new work-group decision about marital-status terminology, not from this historical tracker.

additional_context: FHIR-16516 has the same removal resolution and FHIR-16616 was closed as a duplicate add-missing-codes request. Zulip PA discussion confirms the intended scope was removing the no-longer-needed codesystem-marital-status page while preserving the Patient marital-status ValueSet binding.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because current source already reflects the approved removal and no current source reference to the old CodeSystem canonical or filename remains.
